decision: Half-space A remains the accepted default. Near/far and A+near/far stay explicit experimental controls. Bounded near remains an offline partial correction.

protocol.quality: 256 warmup; one raw frame; 32 consecutive total frames, 8 batches of 4; true post-selection visibility and true texture contribution
protocol.reference: Two nonoverlapping 1024-frame BRDF windows per fixed crop; empirical window-difference/4 uncertainty, not convergence or a confidence interval
protocol.timing: Forward/reverse 128 measured samples, 128-frame immediate metric warmup; final ls4 has an additional source-load warmup. Sum all14 mapped build kernels; initial includes proposal/cube/true trace; shared prepare and sky-LUT sentinel separately recorded. No isolated tree-query or whole-frame timing claim.
protocol.statistics: Common complete finite actual receivers: geometric normal, material, albedo and depth. No brightness cutoff. Sum of RGB channel sample variances, not luminance variance. Raw data never clamped. Display previews use exposure4/Reinhard and counted nonfinite substitutions.

conditional_point_reference.scope: Conditional fixed-point finite-sample RGB moments; offline hypotheses are not GPU or full-ROI acceptance.

probability_diagnostics.scope: Geometry-only actual leaf PMF at the user pixels; divergence is from proposal A, not from measured contribution or actual variance. No visibility inference.

offline_bounded_near.scope: One unimplemented offline correction with conditional RGB M2: replace singular near denominator by max(dmin², AABB half-diagonal², .25), reusing the accepted baseline size floor. A support, far arm, mass, 1/2 mixture and topology fixed. Window1 hypothesis check; disjoint window2 confirmation. Not GPU quality or performance acceptance.

excluded.prior_ls4_cohorts: Initial5776 and repaired5885/554723 quality/timing cohorts retained; final accepted5885/554616 hash22e453. Old BRDF908 reference retained and excluded.
excluded.wrong_length_quality: Three ls4-final quality windows were256 frames and are excluded; accepted ls4-final32 windows explicitly verify32 total frames and8x4 batches.
excluded.original_ls1_ls2_references: Older788 reference windows retained; accepted references are verified replacements with contemporaneous receiver capture.
excluded.oracle_mapping: Initial derived M2 support-fail2 was an unreachable reserved-node mapping error; root-only mapping corrected it. Native raw moments unchanged; independent reconstruction confirms supportfail0 for1/3/6.

limitations: Only selected faces and fixed ROIs, including birch leaves rather than all grass/leaf/background, were checked. The selected ls5 wall did not reproduce the older claimed regression.

Five RGB nonfinite pixel-sample events (15 component events) remain in accepted quality raw data; no numerical-path repair is claimed. Statistics use common complete pixels; previews substitute only for display.
Finite32-frame quality and finite conditional/reference windows. Point predictions are not whole-ROI predictions; offline corrections have no GPU timing or visual acceptance.
ls4 input drift cause remains unknown. Ordered1->2->1 control matched one cohort; it does not establish a mode bug, fix streaming, or guarantee future input stability.
Observed pass costs, two orders only; small differences are not statistically established. Initial includes changed trace work; this is not a standalone query benchmark.
Chrome headless rendering checked; production GI/ReSTIR, dynamic scenes and manual visual acceptance remain outside scope.
